description: This Java source file defines the class TelemetrySenderImpl, which is an implementation of a client for uploading telemetry data to a Hono server using Vertx-Proton for AMQP messaging. It includes methods for creating instances, sending messages asynchronously with tracing support, and generating target addresses, indicating its role in telemetry data transmission within a larger project.

classes.name: TelemetrySenderImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client class for uploading telemetry data to a Hono server, implementing message sending with tracing, timeout handling, and dynamic address calculation.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Generates the target address URI for telemetry data upload, based on tenant ID and optional device ID.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the constant telemetry endpoint string.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new TelemetrySenderImpl instance wrapped in a Future.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, with optional tracing context.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Handles the actual message sending via AMQP with timeout, delivery tracking, and span management.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a new tracing span for message forwarding.

methods.name: startChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a child span for detailed tracing during message transmission.
